items.h: The Seahawks signed White to their practice squad Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
items.s: A little more than a month after cutting White from its practice squad, Seattle has decided to bring him back into the fold ahead of Week 13. If 2022 seventh-rounder Dareke Young (abdomen) is unable to play in Thursday's game against the Cowboys, White could be elevated to the active roster.
